summary: Keep cancelled gate process groups scheduled for teardown when an adoption observation cannot be read.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet rule changes.

compatibility.detail: An indeterminate runtime observation no longer records a stopped gate. Teardown retries the observation and retains SIGKILL escalation on systems without user scopes. Group signalling reports live members found immediately after SIGKILL.

downtime.detail: Restart the daemon to use the fix. Interruption duration has not been measured.

recovery.detail: No persistent state format changes. Rollback restores the previous teardown behavior.
